The longest river in the world is the Nile River.

Regarding the proposed solution for the maximum product triplet problem: The solution is incorrect. Sorting the array and taking the product of the last three elements does not account for cases where two large negative numbers multiply to form a large positive number. In the example input [-10, -10, 5, 2], the correct maximum product is 500 (from -10 * -10 * 5), whereas the proposed method yields -100. A correct approach must compare the product of the three largest numbers with the product of the two smallest (most negative) numbers and the largest number.
